decision.accepted_scope: Account-eligible ETH or SOL already held idle in Binance Spot, not frozen in pending orders, not needed for prompt execution or withdrawal, not allocated by Auto-Subscribe, and below the published eligible cap.
decision.reason: The current official Soft Staking page displays a positive 0.50 percent estimated APR for both ETH and SOL, the official FAQ defines daily native-token rewards from daily-average eligible Spot balances, and participation has no additional fee. This is incremental only relative to holding the same idle native asset without Soft Staking; acquiring ETH or SOL, displacing a superior use, or depending on immediate liquidity is outside the accepted edge.

mechanism.name: binance_soft_staking_idle_spot_native_token_yield
mechanism.purpose: earn native-token staking rewards on otherwise idle organic ETH or SOL Spot inventory without opening a directional position for the reward
mechanism.scope_boundary: The edge is measured against continuing to hold the identical ETH or SOL quantity idle on Binance. Buying the asset, retaining inventory for a forecast, manufacturing balances, or counting assets frozen in pending orders is prohibited.

official_operational_contract.activation_scope: Activating Soft Staking automatically includes all eligible Spot tokens; individual tokens cannot be selected.
official_operational_contract.auto_subscribe_priority: If Auto-Subscribe and Soft Staking are both enabled, Auto-Subscribe allocates eligible assets first and those assets do not participate in Soft Staking.
official_operational_contract.first_reward_timing: Snapshots start at 00:00 UTC on the day after activation and first rewards are distributed two days after activation between 00:00 and 08:00 UTC.
official_operational_contract.liquidity_claim: Official product prose says users can trade withdraw or use eligible tokens anytime.
official_operational_contract.liquidity_warning: The official disclaimer also says assets are allocated to Soft Staking rather than held in Spot while utilised, and prompt return can be delayed when simultaneous withdrawals exceed managed liquidity; redemption and conversion timeframes are not guaranteed.
official_operational_contract.pending_order_rule: Assets frozen in pending Spot orders receive no Soft Staking rewards.
official_operational_contract.rate_rule: APR is estimated, adjusted daily, and not fixed.

signed_api_contract.account_mutation_warning: GET /sapi/v1/soft-staking/set changes account state despite using HTTP GET and must never be treated as read-only evidence.
signed_api_contract.activation_endpoint: GET /sapi/v1/soft-staking/set with required softStaking boolean; USER_DATA signed endpoint
signed_api_contract.product_list_endpoint: GET /sapi/v1/soft-staking/list; USER_DATA signed endpoint returning status totalRewardsUsdt rows and per-row asset minAmount maxCap apr stakedAmount totalProfit
signed_api_contract.rewards_history_endpoint: GET /sapi/v1/soft-staking/history/rewardsRecord; USER_DATA signed endpoint returning asset rewards rewardAsset avgAmount and time
signed_api_contract.safe_next_request: Only after both designated ephemeral Binance credentials exist and explicit read-only authority is given, call the product-list endpoint for ETH and SOL. Activation remains a separate account mutation requiring explicit authority even though its documented method is GET.

unresolved_gates: The public page does not prove this account's regional eligibility activation status current signed APR credited balance or reward history.
The 0.50 percent APR is estimated and can change daily, including becoming economically immaterial or zero.
Assets in pending orders receive no rewards, so this cannot be credited to active quoted inventory or assumed across an order's frozen lifetime.

Binance advertises flexible use but also disclaims guaranteed redemption and conversion timing under liquidity stress. Inventory needed for prompt execution withdrawal collateral or settlement is excluded.
The comparison is only identical already-held idle ETH or SOL. Native-token rewards do not remove the asset's price risk and no asset purchase is justified by this yield.
Tax custody jurisdiction reward rounding and the value of alternative yield uses remain unmeasured.
